notes.title: Early Access Date Revealed 🛠️ Play Free Demo NOW!
notes.content:
Hello, Dwarves!

The date of the First Dwarf Early Access release has been revealed! Watch our completely NEW trailer announcing the exact day that you should RUN to our Steam page!

[previewyoutube=_uvdR-pXNHA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_uvdR-pXNHA[/previewyoutube]
It’s JUNE 19th 2024!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/afca4b263026b37e28aff799029a49260cdbbd9c.png
How much will it cost?

The price of Early Access is going to be 24,99$ / 24,99 Euro / 89,99 PLN / 20,99 GBP 

We are a Polish studio and that’s why we have a very special offer for our Polish gamers! The price in Polish złoty is lower. 😁 If you want to know the price of our game in your country, let us know in the comments!

Along with the announcement of our prices, we prepared a challenge for you, which you can check out below!

Download the DEMO

While we wait for Early Access, our Demo is already available to try for FREE! Did you play it? We’d love to hear your thoughts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712830/First_Dwarf/

Community Challenge! May the whole world hear about First Dwarf!

TA-DA! We have a BIG SURPRISE for you! 🎉

To make things even more exciting, we decided to announce a challenge for all of you! Yes, ALL of you can take part and it’s super easy!

We want to celebrate the Early Access release of First Dwarf with our awesome community. You can earn a launch discount, if our Community Steam Group will get a high enough number.

Here are the 3 goals we established:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0b6b7a4273c4b8822e03bd6c50f0139086979270.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2d347e0a4efb8872f91a9dcd29b0ed4849c80cb5.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/3c5a4dc4e2515a768336cf0672df6b6a9cf29b60.gif

Deadline for meeting the goals is June 19th, the date of First Dwarf Early Access release.

Tell everyone about First Dwarf

By wishlisting First Dwarf you’re not only heightening your chances for the bigger discount during our Early Access launch, but also helps us A TON. For a small indie studio like us, it’s really a big deal. Adding games to your wishlist, helps us with visibility. That means a bigger possibility for success and spreading the love for tough dwarves and dragons!

Do you know the game “Tomato”? Yeah, that’s what you can do now, but change tomato to…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/19e552f408546180e95525aa1c3b1ff511a84c05.gif
May all your friends, all your family and the WHOLE WORLD know about First Dwarf!

Other ways to help us

Adding First Dwarf to your wishlist will really help us a lot, but we’d be extremely happy if you’d follow us on our social media:

 TikTok
 Twitter/X
 Facebook
 Instagram
 LinkedIn
 GameJolt

And MOST importantly, join our Discord server! During the launch there will be plenty of things to discuss and we can’t wait to meet you!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

We are ready!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/f7738a33bfdda24f93aedd76af45c2de21746d9c.jpg

notes.title: Important Update - Future Games Show, developer livestream, release date info
notes.content:
Hi, Dwarves! 🛠

We just CAN’T wait to sum up our recent doings for you! Buckle up, because we have a ton of new info.

Future Games Show Summer Showcase 🌴

Let’s go! We can finally announce that First Dwarf is going to be featured during the upcoming Future Games Show. It’s a very important date for us, as we prepared something exclusively for this event… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/05641449034948e5a9b40fd53b08b875ffc9bc5b.png
We’re going to reveal… our EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE during the Future Games Show on June 8th! Yes, soon there will be no more guessing!


Click here to see the FGS trailer!

Future Games Show covers updates and news from upcoming AAA, as well as indie studios. Watch the broadcast and discover something new! ✨

🎮 Join us on our dev stream! 🎮

And here is the best part… We’ll be livestreaming on that day on Steam! Join us as we’ll be playing First Dwarf and chatting with our two team members, Level and Quest Designer and Community Manager. We can’t wait to see you! ⭐

It’s a wonderful occasion to get to know us and see our game in action!

Will we survive the dangerous adventures on Driftland? We highly encourage you to come see us and chat with us! It’s gonna be a lot of fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b8971ee5d2e26d65d89c3e3aa2dd761799f3abdc.png

BUT! That’s not the only event worth waiting for, becauseeee…

We’re going to CD-Action Expo 2024! 🚀

If you’ll be there too, make sure to stop by and say hi! Meet us at our booth and let’s have a lot of fun during this wonderful event!

Aside from the indie game area, you’ll have a chance to check out the board gaming area, Gothic Village, E-sport section, retro gaming and more!

https://expo.cdaction.pl/


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d5849f64a238f7ae75b72f7fb8b682fecd812591.jpg

Ending Playtest 2.0

Not so long ago we closed our second round of Playtests (as you may know, we extended them due to a high interest). Thank you all so much for helping us once again by giving us your precious feedback! We’ll use it the best we can, to enhance your experience with First Dwarf. 🐉

During the last play testing we were focused on local and online co-op and we’re really happy that many of you wanted to try our game with your friends! Because what’s better than playing First Dwarf? Playing it with your buddy! 🙋🙋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/88bbb07d0a07c92bd8969f777dca919ee6a14d38.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/eb080338aea5798cc294da65b6285fc5372c8418.png

New night view 🌕🌠🌌

Our game is changing every day and recently we decided to upgrade our night escapades a little… Now it’s brighter and clearer which translates to a better view of the world surrounding us. Night flights with Ragna under a full moon looking down right at you… What an unforgettable experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/baea2d897d16297d3f5926cc1e0b088417dfd516.gif

💖 Support the indie 💖

But that’s not the only thing you’ve been asking! We get a lot of questions about how someone can help us, and there are a couple of things that you can do to aid us.

Add our game to your Steam wishlist! When a title is wishlisted by a lot of people, it gives us more visibility. It’s super easy and really helps us a ton.

You can also follow our game on Steam! This way you won’t miss a thing when it comes to news and updates. Join our fantasy adventure!

And the best place to chat with us and see what we are up to is, of course, our Discord server! You can write there about absolutely everything you want, it’s the easiest way to leave us your feedback, which is really important for us. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

This simple “click” where Ragna is pointing, will teleport you to the magical world… Become a part of our journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/7d8a8410aece477058d15d698911a8c109e941b3.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/def9931da3d6191606bdd61ccfbdadb1f4a1a304.png

[previewyoutube=k_3QfJYCJM4;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k_3QfJYCJM4[/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/6c6b7ec380d0b875ea34a8d06527133598290d00.png

As always, thank you so much for being with us and for your support! We absolutely can’t wait to share more great news in the near future. Have a great day and see you soon!

notes.title: Dev Update #15 - New Puzzle, Skill Tree and more!
notes.content:
Hi, Dwarves! 🛠

We’re BACK with a new article! 👏 *round of applause* 👏 Since the last Dev Update we added some new content into the game and we would love to share it with you! We’re super excited about it and hope that you’ll like it just as we do. Let’s take a closer look at what we’ve been up to!

First weekend with co-op ahead

Last Monday we started our 2nd round of Playtests! Now it’s Friday and many of you already expressed their experiences with co-op and the new build of our game. If you couldn’t join us during the past days, there is no better time to do it than now! Let’s dive into the game this weekend!

Play with your friend locally or online and let the fun begin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b66f540a58d0e1bafbca22324c50c82f5fdcd256.gif

Remember that everyone can join our Playtest on Steam! All you have to do is click “Request Access” on First Dwarf’s Steam Page!

And join our Discord! That’s the best way to chat with us and leave feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

Skill Tree

Recently one of our main focuses was preparing the skill tree. By gaining experience points in the game, you can use them to upgrade your characters. Mech, Tru and Ragna have separate skill trees and different skills to unlock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/311ecccd67ba1a5852740e54a01cb04998838951.gif

If you were with us during our first Playtest, you could’ve seen the placeholder Ragna model. She’s gone (and will be missed), BUT has been replaced with the cool animation!

Characters in the menu are interactive, hover over them to see their reactions! 

However, for now, we didn’t resign completely from goofy images and in the skill tree you can see the adorable cat of one of our team members that became our mascot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b15cd7a208cb24280070a392dbe1df475f3c9954.png

New puzzle

But wait, there's more!

There is a new puzzle for Ragna that you can encounter on one of the floating islands… Collect the blue orbs and find the hidden treasure! Dragon wings are irreplaceable when it comes to searching through inaccessible locations. She’s also an incredible swimmer! Her diving skill will have an upgrade option in the future, so she can hold her breath underwater even longer. Very convenient!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/058d6a2f24097bf82703bf194a8cd497645800bd.gif

Also, as you can see above, there are some mysterious roots growing near the orbs. That’s our work-in-progress-plant! Let’s look at the concepts below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/559dc02fa021947f8c48c35416332bbd47d00945.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c815058058dede5c3322d35fe1d42a524629b3c8.png

This weird stone-like plant is emitting the mana fumes… What could it exactly mean and how is this plant connected to the ecosystem? The world of Driftland hides many secrets, will you manage to find them all? Try to do it during the ongoing Playtest and search the area everywhere you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/08e2a4b3fccd02cd7e8ed32a8881ba879184f05e.png

❤️Add to your wishlist!❤️

Remember to add our game to your wishlist! By doing so, you help us a lot! ❤️ Also, we encourage you to add First Dwarf: First Island (our upcoming free prologue) to your lists as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_Prologue__First_Island/

Thank you for reading and for your support! And if you wish to be up to date with us, check out our social media!

We’ll continue to keep you up to date on our progress in the future Dev Updates! Stay tuned.
Have a great weekend full of games!

Yours,
Star Drifters team 🌟🚀

notes.title: Playtest 2.0 - online co-op mode and new update
notes.content:
Today is the day, Dwarves! 🛠

Thanks to your feedback from the 1st Playtest we decided to speed up the second round! First Dwarf Playtest 2.0 will feature fixes that players pointed out in previous tests as well as the first alfa version of our online and local co-op mode and some new things to do on the island! Make sure your Playtest is updated to 0.253 version!

PS. We tried to fix as many things as we could in the time that we had and this is not the end of the fixes!

It’s our first try with co-op in First Dwarf, so please keep in mind that it’s still a work in progress. That’s why your feedback can really help us with polishing the mechanics of multiplayer!

When? ⏰

Playtest starts TODAY and ends in two weeks on the 6th of May 7PM (CEST).

Who can participate? 🤔

Just like last time, everyone can participate! If you had access to the 1st Playtest, you don’t have to request it again. There will be an update for you to download in your game library. 

If you didn’t request access during our 1st Playtest, you can do it right now and up until 6th of May 7PM (CEST). Remember that when the clock hits the ending date, access to the game will be disabled.

What’s N E W ✨

Thanks to all your feedback that we gathered (for which we are extremely grateful!), we fixed some bugs, text errors and mechanics. Now you can charge mana and fix buildings twice as fast.  

One of the main changes that’s easy to detect is making the buildings that are disconnected from the mana pipes glow red. This way it’s easier to tell if they’re functional!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8f8b1b5a22055f3d943e994e04b9d6d7168b09f6.gif

There is also a new puzzle for Ragna added, so you have more opportunities to use her beautiful wings!

Play with your friend! 🐉🧔‍♂️

We know that a lot of you were waiting for our online and local co-op mode! And now the first taste is finally available for you to try!

In a single-player game you can switch between characters, completing tasks with the one with better skills in a given field.

In co-op, you can share a splitscreen locally, by making one person join with a gamepad and the second one playing with a keyboard, or you can invite a friend online and play on separate devices. Tru and Ragna have separate skills to develop and upgrade, strengths and weaknesses, so it’s important to choose the characters wisely when preparing to complete specific tasks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/bb239e9bce104b0cb81a6a1f0be5ae7b91750389.png

You can change characters during the co-op gameplay, but you can’t control the same character at the same time. Mech can be controlled by both Ragna and Tru.

[previewyoutube=uKQD5H9-OSA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uKQD5H9-OSA[/previewyoutube]

Camera shake slider

We acknowledged that many of you felt discomfort caused by the shaking of the camera. From now on, you can adjust that motion and if you wish, turn it off completely.

Please tell us your thoughts on this change! We hope that now you can enjoy the game with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/cb085232a828f582c9efb196e73d9a65f679d544.png

📜 Change log 📜

New:

 Camera shake slider
 Pop-up tutorial added for combo and high jump
 New system of communicating unpowered building (red glow if not connected)
 First iteration of development tree:

[olist]
 mech [mana refueling speed, more stamina, faster repairing]
 Tru [faster mech repairing, automatic mine improvement, automatic sawmill improvement]
 Ragna [More stamina]
[/olist]
 New environment puzzle for Ragna 
 Side quest: Eskoim Hammer
 New behaviors for settlers depending on the time of the day (sleeping, working, resting)
 Option for turning on/off tower radius display
 Added 2 new enemies (they are a lot tougher!)
 Added translation of some missing texts in a few languages
 New sounds added (monster nests, mech swimming and more)

Changes:

 Doubled the repairing speed
 Doubled the speed of mana extraction with mech
 Mech high jump and gliding improved
 Improved clarity and hints for Workshop quest  
 The way to the second island has been made easier to traverse
 Improved Ragna scouting mechanic
 Improved Ragna’s fire breathing and aiming  (still needs some tweaking)
 Experience points for quests, destroying monster nests, destroying monsters, etc. have been balanced with the level system in the game
 Mysterious flying object “upgraded” #spooky

Fixes:

 Adjusted audio in intro cutscene
 Some language errors fixed
 Names of some objectives corrected
 Fixed bug with Raven sending and the Port
 Menu sounds tweaked
 Mortar Tower rotation bug fixed
 Tru’s stance fixed while repairing the mech, Mech’s stance fixed while retrieving mana
 and some lot of smaller fixes

Your Feedback 🖱🎮

We’re counting on your feedback! Let’s create the game together and share some ideas! We’ll be very grateful for more of your thoughts during the second round of play testing.

Here is the reminder on how to do it:

First method is:

 First Dwarf Discord server

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

You’ll find there a special Playtest category:

playtest-bugs - here you can send us all the information about encountered bugs (happens to the best of us), see pinned messages in that channel for more information, so we could have the best understanding of the problem and could fix it in the future!

feedback - that’s the place where you can tell us EVERYTHING you want after you played our game. Positive and negative feedback, all of that is welcome. You can tell us about the smallest things, regarding music, characters, dialogues, mechanics, systems… Every topic is a good topic, as long as it’s related to the First Dwarf Playtest. We can’t wait to chat with you about your experiences with our title! 

language-bugs - here you can post all language related errors. Please have in mind that the game is still in progress and so are the languages, so translations may have some mistakes. We apologize for that. They are in beta version, and will be improved with time. Texts and dialogues can also be altered later, if necessary. You can change the language in the game’s menu options!

opt-in-credits - here you can read the steps of what to do, to be included in our final game’s credits! It’s a little “thank you” from us, for all your help. By leaving your invaluable feedback, you’re becoming an important part of our big adventure! You’ll find there the link to the form we prepared earlier, where you’ll be able to drop your nickname. No offensive names of course, those won’t be included.

If you gave us your nickname in the last Playtest, you don’t have to write it again. 👍

Second method for leaving feedback:

 In the game itself, as seen below

Probably the fastest way to report a bug is located directly in the game. An automatic save file is also attached to the report you make (but you won't see it, so don't panic!). However, keep in mind that we won’t be able to respond to you there. We will receive the information, but to hear back from us or to engage in conversation, it’s best to use Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8dc5c9fb5261fa46563efe193510f9861a50f77e.png

Third method to leave feedback:

 Steam Discussion on the game’s page

Fill the Form! 📝

We prepared a simple form to fill, which may inspire you in terms of what to be aware of while playing. After leaving your feedback, you can also write your nickname to be put in the final game’s credits there, it’s optional. If you gave us your nickname in the last Playtest, you don’t have to write it again. 👍

https://forms.gle/zkZLTsh76H6CePz37

Can I stream my game?📸

YES! Feel free to tag us and show off on our Discord server, we would love to see it! You can freely post about it on your social media. Even more! You can use our Press Kit, if you wish:

First Dwarf Press Kit

Earth Appreciation Festival

Today is Earth Day! It’s a very important date and we do what we can to remind everyone about it! Earth Appreciation Festival is a list of specially selected games that focus on a post-apocalyptic grim atmosphere of a future that we should avoid. 

But not only that! You can also find nature-focused games there, to appreciate all the good things about Earth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/6f270c1e07445b42acc402fd94f90cd1eb7fd9bc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5a2c07be1bbc1ddb7f5fbb47eaa27bb54d0e68a5.png

Are you ready? 🏁

And that’s about it! We hope that the changes we made recently will positively influence your experience. Let us know!

❤️ Add to your wishlist ❤️

Remember that adding our games to your wishlist on Steam is a wonderful way to show your support! We’d be very grateful if you could consider adding First Dwarf to your lists, as well as our upcoming prologue, First Dwarf: First Island!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_Prologue__First_Island/


Thank you all for reading and for your support! We deeply care about our project and want to improve it even further! It can be possible with your help. 

Have fun play testing our newest build of First Dwarf and have a wonderful day!

Yours,
Star Drifters Team 🌟🚀

notes.title: First Round of Playtest - A Summary
notes.content:
Hi, Dwarves! 🧔

As we promised, we’re back in the blink of an eye! 👁👁 During the last two weeks we were focused on our ongoing Playtest. We want to show you some awesome statistics and our thoughts on how it all went! (Spoiler: it went great.)

Contest Results! 📜🏆

During our Playtest, we organized a contest for the best colony! 

In our game, you can build your very own settlement, filled with various types of defensive turrets, defensive walls and buildings. Everything connected with mana pipes! How you do it in detail is up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d76c0107047106895660396f3d8446c5283c5acb.gif

Thanks to everyone who participated, we had a chance to see their amazing takes on how the greatest dwarven settlement could look like! Players did not disappoint! As we promised, the winners get free keys to one of our previous games!

Round of applause for our talented scouting engineers! Just look at these masterpieces!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/7a14b648d6652172dec03983ed0957e2c076f2bf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/68b9d056075645dfcea0d778778f347f3bc69b92.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/f7f0a9ea9c012dad1c9195e5dffb33be53ec8f9d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/89e1f6d02ab5eeeb613480344b1cfc22e2006676.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/a3674cbb7ba99989eab37fbca2fd19ee90375a5b.png

What would your dwarven colony look like? 

Precious Feedback

Main reason that pushed us to launch our Playtest was the possibility of getting some feedback from our community and let us tell you, we got A LOT! And that’s absolutely fantastic! 🌟

We are very happy that much of the feedback from players aligns with our production pipelines and what we would like to add and improve in the game. Many important points were made and we will definitely benefit from all the things that have been said in our Discord, Steam Discussions, reports and in our feedback form. Overall, our game has been reviewed very positively by most and we couldn’t have wished for more!

🌸 We’re extremely grateful for all the tips and feedback we’ve received! Thanks to you, First Dwarf will blossom with each day! 🌸

Playtest in numbers

We know that some of you like to dive into specifics, so here are more detailed statistics for all the curious gamers out there:

👑 16 000 signed up for the Playtest 
👑 Favorite part of the game: building
👑 20 000 added First Dwarf to their wishlists
👑 460 gamers will be added to our credits in the final game after our 1st Playtest
👑 97,3% positive reviews
👑 93% of gamers used mouse and keyboard to play

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5e92930e4fa42735ede4c66b7de50f7181da8c40.png

So what’s next? 🤔

Another Playtest! We know that some of you were very eager to play more and there also were people who didn’t manage to join us for the first playtesting. So don't worry! We’ll be holding a new Playtest with an improved build. All of you who already had a chance to play First Dwarf will be able to experience the changes we implemented and compare it with older version of our game. And, of course, we’ll welcome everyone who wants to join us for the first time, the more the merrier! 😄 

Stay tuned for more info soon!

If you don’t want to miss any news from us, it’s best to keep track of our actions on our social media!

🌟 Twitter/X
🌟 TikTok 
🌟 Facebook 
🌟 Instagram 
🌟 LinkedIn 
🌟 GameJolt 

And the BEST place to talk with us is obviously our First Dwarf Discord server! Don’t be shy, join us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

When you wish upon a… Dwarf 🌟

Adding games to your wishlist is a very easy way to support developers! Consider wishlisting First Dwarf: First Island, our upcoming free prologue!

We would be very grateful if you could add it to your wished games! As well as the main First Dwarf game! 🧔🐉🤖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_Prologue__First_Island/

notes.title: The Start of First Dwarf Playtest!
notes.content:
How are you today, Dwarves? Excited as we are? We sure hope so! 🍀🌟

3…2…1… Off you go to the Driftland world! IGN Gameplay

Let’s start with some amazing news! IGN released a 15 minute long video with the newest gameplay of First Dwarf! Accompanied by an informative voice over, you can dive into the fantasy world of Driftland and see the most up to date mechanics, graphics and systems that we’ve been working on! It’s a great opportunity to get to know the specifics of our game in a very detailed way. 🛠🤖

You can check it out below:

[previewyoutube=9Yo2cw3P3AE;full][/previewyoutube]

First Ever First Dwarf Playtest

And without further ado… Today is a BIG day for us! If you’ve been following our Community Hub and our social media, you could’ve heard about sign-ups for our Playtests. But in case you somehow didn’t get the memo, don’t worry! Put on your dwarven shoes anyway, because you can still join us! Just go to the Steam page of First Dwarf and click “Request Access” 🎯

Who will get access?

Everyone who signed-up will participate! 🎉 So no worries, it doesn't matter if you requested it right after our announcement, or even after the Playtest started, you’ll be able to play First Dwarf. 🎉

When does the Playtest start and end?

Playtests are open from March 25th 3PM (UTC +1) to April 8th 3PM (UTC +1). We’re going to give access to the game to everyone who signed-up. In this time window, you can still request access to the game. After April 8th, the Playtests will be closed, gamers will lose their access to the game, but there is a possibility of a second round in the future.

What exactly is the Playtest and why are we organizing it?

Steam Playtest is a wonderful feature that lets us give access to the game to the players who are willing to try it out in its current state. Our main reason for this, is willingness to receive as much feedback as we can, before launching the final game. We believe that the thoughts and opinions of our community will help us shape the game together and create something truly brilliant. We deeply care about this project, as it’s related to our first game, Driftland: The Magic Revival, and we are over the moon that we have the opportunity to expand this magical world even further. That’s why we need YOUR HELP!

But how can I help?

Well, that’s super easy! After getting access to the game…just play the game! That’s phase number one. And phase number two, is…

Leave your Feedback!

There are 3 places where you can report bugs, issues and leave feedback!

First method is:

 First Dwarf Discord server

We highly encourage you all to leave us your feedback, even if it’s just a few words (but the more you say, the better, of course!). You can do it in our First Dwarf Discord server, which we already upgraded with special channels for the Playtest. If you already are on our Discord, you know that it’s really fun there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

We added two new channels specifically for this event:

playtest-feedback - that’s the place where you can tell us EVERYTHING you want after you played our game. Positive and negative feedback, all of that is welcome. You can tell us about the smallest things, regarding music, characters, dialogues, mechanics, systems, bugs… Every topic is a good topic, as long as it’s related to the First Dwarf Playtest. We can’t wait to chat with you about your experiences with our title! 

opt-in-credits - here you can read the steps of what to do, to be included in our game’s credits! It’s a little “thank you” from us, for all your help. By leaving your invaluable feedback, you’re becoming an important part of our big adventure! You’ll find there the link to the form we prepared earlier, where you’ll be able to drop your nickname. No offensive names of course, those won’t be included.

Second method for leaving feedback:

 In the game itself, as seen below

Probably the fastest way to report a bug is located directly in the game. An automatic save file is also attached to the report you make (but you won't see it, so don't panic!), so we have the best understanding of the issue. However, keep in mind that we won’t be able to respond to you there. We will receive the information, but to hear back from us or to engage in conversation, it’s best to use Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8dc5c9fb5261fa46563efe193510f9861a50f77e.png

Third method to leave feedback:

 Steam Discussion dedicated to the event

We made a pinned thread in the Steam Discussions titled 🐛 Playtest Bug Reports 🐛, where you can report your bugs from the Playtest. 

Fill the Form!

If you’re not sure how to phrase what’s in your mind, we prepared a simple form to fill, which may help you transfer your thoughts into words and inspire you in terms of what to be aware of while playing. After leaving your feedback, you can also write your preferred name to be put in the credits there, it’s optional.

Feedback Form First Dwarf

Available Languages

We deeply care about your experience with First Dwarf and that’s why we prepared additional languages for the Playtest. Which include:

Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, English, Spanish - Spain, French, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0d0aa32c000b92daa7dd1a0c36f75c6e860fb09d.gif

Please have in mind that the game is still in progress and so are the languages, so translations may have some mistakes. We apologize for that. They are in beta version, and will be improved with time. You can change the language in the game’s menu options! Texts and dialogues can also be altered later, if necessary.

Can I stream my game?📸

YES! Feel free to tag us and show off on our Discord server, we would love to see it! You can freely post about it on your social media. Even more! You can use our Press Kit, if you wish:

First Dwarf Press Kit

What’s in the Playtest?

The best part! What’s awaiting you during our Playtest? Well, let us tell you!

You’ll be playtesting an introduction to our game, First Dwarf. Take on the role of Tru, chosen to be the First Dwarf and his sassy dragon companion Ragna. Your mission is to build a new colony on the freshly discovered island, but first, you need to make sure that the area is safe to inhabit. Gather resources, build your base and fortify your colony, before the evil monster wave attacks! Fight your enemies by placing defensive turrets and engaging in direct combat. Complete your quests and send the raven to the awaiting dwarves, so they can arrive at their new home. Will you and your people survive in this new environment? 🧔‍♂️🐉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/da2a9c9e559fc6d0034726e4cd932c11aeadba0c.gif

❤️ Add to Your Wishlist ❤️

We’re also preparing an advanced special version of Demo, titled First Dwarf: First Island. We highly encourage you to add it to your Wishlist (it has its own Steam Page) as well as the final First Dwarf game. We will give more information soon! It will help us show the world that the love people have for dwarves is immeasurable.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_First_Island/

Final Thoughts

And that’s basically it! Easy, right? If you have ANY additional questions, don’t be afraid and ask us on our Discord server or in the comments. We hope to discuss with you many, many different topics and create a wonderful game together!

Have fun playing First Dwarf and see you in our Discord server!

Yours,
Star Drifters Team ✨🚀
